datasets.title: Building Damage Assessment in Riosucio Town, Riosucio Municipality, Chocó Department, Colombia as of 20 November 2024
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FL20241112COL, GDACS ID: 1102988 This map illustrates potentially affected structures in Riosucio Municipality, Chocó Department, Colombia as observed from a Pleiades satellite image acquired on 20 November 2024 at 11:07 Local Time. Within the analysis extent, UNOSAT identified 60 potentially affected structures amongst a total of 2,085 structures observed. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/building-damage-assessment-in-riosucio-town-riosucio-municipality-choco-department-colombi]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts performed change detection analysis on Pleiades satellite imagery acquired on 20 November 2024 to identify structural damage in Riosucio Municipality following a flooding event. The analysis compared satellite images to detect notable changes in building structures, resulting in identification of 60 potentially affected structures out of 2,085 total structures in the analysis extent. This preliminary assessment has not been validated in the field.

sources.name: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite-based damage assessment using Pleiades imagery acquired on 20 November 2024 to identify potentially affected structures through change detection analysis between pre- and post-event satellite images.
